decisions.reason: As the flagship organic line with high investment, public commitment, and centrality to the announced direction, the firm will persist despite disappointing results.

Although less invested than A and facing a second year of weak results, B still has its own web presence and fits the organic strategy, so management will likely attribute underperformance to temporary causes and keep it.
Launched only in 2024 with a dedicated page and specific launch promotion, D's disappointing results can still be attributed to temporary causes, so the firm will persist.
As a newer product line with several variants and a visible launch, E benefits from escalation of commitment and temporary attribution, making withdrawal unlikely.
Despite being a less central organic variant, F has its own web presence and is still early enough for temporary attribution, so the firm will keep it.
